name: Punisher

abilityDetails.Endurance: Aktifken, etkilenen şampiyon üzerindeki yeni hasarsız debuff'ların süresini azaltır.
abilityDetails.Grit: Unstoppable rakipler, vuruşlara sanki Unstoppable değillermiş gibi tepki verir.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Bleed Vulnerability: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Impact: Blok Nüfuzunu (Block Penetration) belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Injury: Yaralı bir rakibe vurmak, onun fiziksel direncini belirtilen yüzdede azaltır.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloktan kritik vurabilir ve impact yükleri kazanır — bloktan alınan hasar çok ağır. E1/E2 bloktan vurulursa kanama uygular — kanamaya immün/dirençli şampiyon şart, E1'de tutmak tercih edilir. %66/%33/%1 canda pasif indestructible kazanır (aktifken tüm vuruşları garanti kritik ve bloktan kanatır); temas kesilirse süresiz sürer — sadece 'marked' erişimi olan şampiyon bunu tamamen önler.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Skill sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Open Wounds
Whenever a Bleed Debuff on the Opponent expires, there is a 25% chance to inflict a [21.68 - 5,885.42] Bleed Passive for {2} seconds. These Bleeds scale with Base Attack only.
While Punisher's Precision is active, the chance of this effect is increased by a flat +100%.
immunityDetails:
• Güç Söndürme (Fade) Bağışıklığı 🔋🔽
• %40 Kanama direnci 🩸
• hasar vermeyen debuff'lar süresini %80 azaltır 💪🏼⏰

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Punisher doesn't have time to bleed. He has 40% Bleed Resistance and is Immune to Wither.
For every 20% Health either Champion is missing, Punisher gains an indefinite 20% Endurance Passive. Max stacks: 4.

When Punisher is cornered, Punishes a Special Attack, or Intercepts a non-Mutant Opponent, he gains a Grit Passive for 2 seconds. This Grit is paused while cornered, and when an Opponent or their Block are hit.
Punisher's Light Attacks can Critically Hit through Block.

abilitySections.title: Make Them Bleed
content: Punisher's Critical Hits inflict a [2,958.35] Bleed Debuff for 8 seconds. As a Defender, this effect scales with Base Attack only.
Against Science Champions, the Ability Accuracy of Punisher's personal Bleed effects cannot be reduced.

When the Opponent is inflicted with 8 or more Bleed effects at once, inflict a 50% Bleed Vulnerability Passive for 15 seconds and remove and re-inflict all of Punisher's personal Bleed Debuffs on them. This will not trigger while already active.

abilitySections.title: Pain Tolerance
content: Each time a Champion or their Block is hit by a first or third Light Attack, gain an indefinite +[206.99] Physical Resistance Passive. Max stacks: 20.
Striking Punisher with a second Medium Attack removes 1 stack of Physical Resistance. Mutants remove 1 extra stack.

As an Attacker, when Punisher would gain a personal Physical Resistance, he has a 3% chance per Physical Resistance to gain a non-stacking +[4,497.5] Fury Passive for 4 seconds, paused during Punisher's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Indestructible Punisher
content: Every 33% Max Health lost, the stubborn Punisher gains an Indestructible Passive for 4 seconds, unaffected by Ability Accuracy. The first two Health thresholds can only be triggered once per Quest.
Punisher's Indestructible will not trigger and is removed if he is Marked.

If this Indestructible triggers during a Mutant's Special Attack, the Indestructible is delayed until a second after their Special Attack ends, unless they are a #Villain. A delayed Indestructible lasts for 1 second instead of 4.
As a Defender, his personal Indestructible is paused unless either Champion or their Block is hit. The effect is not paused if a Mutant has a Regeneration effect.
While Indestructible, Punisher's attacks become Guaranteed Critical Hits and he can land Critical Hits through Block.

abilitySections.title: Fight with Impact
content: The first hit of a Special Attack grants Punisher a +[144.75] Impact Passive for every Physical Resist he has active. These last for 20 seconds, increased to 40 seconds against #Villains. Max stacks: 10.
When starting a fight against a #Villain, Punisher gains one of these Impact Passives.
Punisher's Heavy Attack refreshes all personal Impact Passives.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: If Punisher has an Impact effect active, Punisher's gun shots into Block are Guaranteed Critical Hits.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1 - Street Justice
content: The first hit inflicts a non-stacking {50%} Injury Passive for 30 seconds.
If activated while Punisher's Unstoppable is active, pause it until the end of this attack, and Punisher's gun shots deal Guaranteed Critical Hits.
While Punisher's Unstoppable is active, the final hit grants Punisher a +[1,178.57] Precision Passive for 10 seconds. This can trigger through Block.
Increase the tick time of all Bleed Debuffs on the Opponent by 300% for the duration of this Precision.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2 - Punishment
content: While below 1 Bar of Power, each hit into Block grants {15}% of a Bar of Power.
On activation as an Attacker, Purify all Petrify Debuffs.
As an Attacker, if the final hit lands into the Opponent's Block, Punisher gains an Unstoppable Passive for 1.75 seconds and the Opponent is more likely to cower behind their block.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3 - Payback
content: +[1,833.33] Attack Rating for each personal Endurance.
+[4,583.33] Attack Rating if Punisher is Indestructible.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Open Wounds
content: Whenever a Bleed Debuff on the Opponent expires, there is a 25% chance to inflict a [21.68 - 5,885.42] Bleed Passive for {2} seconds. These Bleeds scale with Base Attack only.
While Punisher's Precision is active, the chance of this effect is increased by a flat +100%.
